title: Among all molecules that contain at least one triple bond, find the element
question: Among all molecules that contain at least one triple bond, find the element that appears in the fewest of these molecules and determine how many of those molecules are carcinogenic.

prediction.sql:
WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_003, COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS mol_count
    FROM triple_bond_molecules AS m
    INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
least_frequent_element AS (
    SELECT XCL_003
    FROM element_counts
    ORDER BY mol_count ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010)
FROM triple_bond_molecules AS m
INNER JOIN molecule AS mo ON m.XCL_010 = mo.XCL_010
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
INNER JOIN least_frequent_element AS lfe ON a.XCL_003 = lfe.XCL_003
WHERE mo.XCL_011 = '+'

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_003, COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS mol_count
    FROM triple_bond_molecules AS m
    INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
least_frequent_element AS (
    SELECT XCL_003
    FROM element_counts
    ORDER BY mol_count ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010)
FROM triple_bond_molecules AS m
INNER JOIN molecule AS mo ON m.XCL_010 = mo.XCL_010
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
INNER JOIN least_frequent_element AS lfe ON a.XCL_003 = lfe.XCL_003
WHERE mo.XCL_011 = '+'

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_003, COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS mol_count
    FROM triple_bond_molecules AS m
    INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
least_frequent_element AS (
    SELECT XCL_003
    FROM element_counts
    ORDER BY mol_count ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010)
FROM triple_bond_molecules AS m
INNER JOIN molecule AS mo ON m.XCL_010 = mo.XCL_010
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
INNER JOIN least_frequent_element AS lfe ON a.XCL_003 = lfe.XCL_003
WHERE mo.XCL_011 = '+'

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    a.XCL_003 AS element,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = 'carcinogenic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
JOIN connected c1 ON a.XCL_001 = c1.XCL_007
JOIN connected c2 ON a.XCL_001 = c2.XCL_008
JOIN bond b ON c1.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
WHERE b.XCL_006 = 'triple'
GROUP BY a.XCL_003
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) ASC
LIMIT 1
